title: Knights' War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Knights' War", at revision 1370947288, opens: "The Knights' War, also known as the Imperial Knights' Revolt, was a failed attempt by the Brotherly Convention led by the Evangelical knight Franz von Sickingen to forcibly remove Richard, Prince-Bishop of Trier and secularize his lands. The private feud resulted in the death of Sickingen and likely inspired the German Peasants' War of 1524–1526." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q569485, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "16th-century conflict in the Holy Roman Empire". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
